title.zh: DeepSeek与华为联手挑战英伟达AI算力霸权：参与下一代芯片设计，年底冲刺国产芯片预训练

current_state.zh: DeepSeek and Huawei are deepening collaboration on next-generation Ascend chip design, with Huawei reserving most 960DT supply for DeepSeek and DeepSeek aiming to start pretraining on domestic 950DT chips by year-end.
